findings: Supported-planet oblique shows the three bushed pins, alternating ring bolts and common pin ring. These were absent from the preceding small-gear candidate.

Pin section exposes the separate steel sleeve and bronze bush, hollow pin, reused dished plug, nut and split pin. Ring-bolt section exposes the opposite insertion direction and recessed nut/cotter seat. Cast shoulders and hardware profiles are inferred.

Combined cutaway shows both planetary trains with their physical support stacks. The input disk now has a cubic swept transition to the riveted rim. No native placement is changed for these inspection sections.

Actual native/source overlay retains the original conditional scale. The rivet center now projects to source pixel1065; its previous15.0218mm axial discrepancy is resolved at that chosen source pick. The nominal rivet/case gap is0.569988mm, overturning the earlier collision concern.

The source rivet/head outline is shorter than the retained printed-stock reconstruction; matching its center does not establish the historical grip or head contour. Disk transition poles and radial stations remain assumptions.

The small planet/pin center remains7.25714mm outside the approximate illustrated radius. Printed tooth counts and pitch control the gear centers. The M276 printed tooth-row and M272/M273 naming conflicts remain recorded.
First swept trial left about0.0227mm3 overlap beneath each rivet head. Ending the curve atR204.5 rather than206 leaves a flat seating land; final416 material pairs have no detected overlaps.

One raw coincident-face STEP cut failed for a cotter. Bounded fuzzy material comparisons preserve all94 exported solids without increasing stored tolerances; all8 deliberately shifted1micron solids are detected by the independent checker.

The high-speed drum and external sun-sleeve/brake-bearing region still differ from the illustrated contours. M265/M266 bearings, M290 retention and adjacent spline/hub profiles require joint refinement next.
accepted_scope: Nominal static small planet supports and swept disk/ring revision. No full transmission, thread load, historical fit, motion or parameter-envelope qualification.
next: Refine the external M267/M269/M277 bearing stack; add M265/M266, M290 retainers and M300 cap dowels, then central bevel/input and remaining case/brake/lubrication work before standard integration.
